research_scope: Reconciliation corrections for Future Saga Chapter 4 skills after a dedicated PQ185/PQ186 reward-slot audit and independent Power to Overcome mechanics review.

verification_audit.method: Compared canonical Awoken records against current Xenoverse 2-specific Awoken references and the maintained research corpus.

corrections.name: Pure Progress
corrections.evidence: Pure Progress is used by Hit and is inaccessible to CaCs.

corrections.name: Super Saiyan Blue Kaioken
corrections.evidence: SSGSS Kaioken is cast-exclusive rather than an obtainable CaC Awoken transformation.

corrections.name: Supersonic Mode
corrections.evidence: Supersonic Mode is Dyspo's cast-exclusive Awoken state.

notes: Historical batches remain unchanged; this correction supersedes incorrect CaC availability in the canonical skill layer.
